literal: Rumour to-be-ashamed-of is-it-possible, "fear-not dispel" he-who-said, many-people to-be-ashamed when-abandoned?
translation: When the one who once said "Fear not" has abandoned me to the shame of many, is it possible for me to shy away from public rumour?
modern: அஞ்சாதே என்று அன்று உறுதியளித்தவர், இன்று பலரும் வெட்கப்படும்படி என்னை விட்டுப் பிரிந்த நிலையில், ஊரார் தூற்றும் பழிச்சொல்லுக்கு நான் வெட்கப்பட முடியுமோ?
explanation: The heroine laments her lover's departure and the resulting public gossip. He had previously promised to protect her and told her not to fear, but has now abandoned her in a way that makes even onlookers feel ashamed. Since he has broken his vow and left her exposed, she asks how she can possibly hide from or feel ashamed of the public rumour, as the damage is already done.
